strings: r_c0 sits back and watches as m_c comes in just to reorder and count the herbs in the medicine den.
m_c decided to reorganise the entire fresh-kill pile into multiple piles of prey, sorted by size.
Before {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could go on patrol, m_c needed to go back and forth between the camp and the start of the patrol route before {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} nodded and could proceed.
m_c has to stop every few minutes to shake off {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws.
When settling down to sleep, m_c has to get up and check the front of the den three times.
m_c keeps grooming the same spot on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} pelt.
m_c keeps repeating behaviours and when asked can only explain that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/need/needs} to do them.
